notes.title: 4 new maps and hotfix available!
notes.notes:
Hello friends of strategy,

today we are releasing 4 new maps in our known biomes. We are planning 2 more extreme biomes for an even bigger challenge until the release.
With this update, problems in particular with the newly introduced characters should be fixed. Units now stay in formation until combat and also on overseas voyages
should work better now. Of course there were some other adjustments in the code as well.

The release of the patch took a little longer because we tried to implement a feature that unfortunately cannot be integrated because it caused too many problems.

If we find or receive further bugs, we will release another hotfix, otherwise work will now continue towards the 1.0 release.
The current plan for 1.0 is late September / early October, which will be 1-2 months longer than we originally planned.

Thank you for your understanding and we hope you enjoy playing!

notes.title: Update 0.8 is now live!
notes.notes:
After more than 400+ minor and major changes, bug fixes and improvements since the last news, the time has finally come.
We are happy to provide the next major update!

Many new mechanics should enrich the game and give you more decision-making options.
These include, among other things, an expanded government, mining and city administration.
The new resident mechanics complement the game and will be expanded and improved until release.
It is now also possible to start building a small dynasty and marrying and creating successors. You can do all of this in the new
resident details, as each resident now has their own property menu. There will also be improvements here until the release.
In the cities, the focus has shifted more strongly to the marketplace, where visitors and dealers can now shop and bring gold into the city.
Character creation has been expanded and now has a greater impact on the game. All residents also use new RPG elements and get better at work and office with experience.
Fights are now better represented visually in the world. Soldiers are now visible in the world and fight directly, which should provide more tactical depth. More will come till 1.0 here too.
Residents now also represent themselves in the world and are no longer simply randomly selected as before.

Otherwise there are new buildings, new products and raw materials, new research, you can finally save your game saves in your own files and the manual construction of buildings in the city is now possible.
Of course, that wasn't all, but there should also be something left to discover.

An intermediate patch with necessary bug fixes, a new map and another planned improvement is planned for the end of May or the beginning of June.
We hope to have caught as many bugs as possible in the last few weeks, but as this is a small team, we ask for your understanding. Especially in the late game it is due to the many
Opportunities, despite the high investment of time, are not so easy after the amount of adjustments to the game.

What happens after the hotfix:
The basic course of the game is in place. The game starts slowly and calmly and then becomes more intense. If you enjoy it, you can look forward to the further patches.
Of course we try to add a few more things where it makes sense so that we can experience a little more, especially in the early game.
Before the 1.0 release, we are planning at least 3 larger features and of course many improvements and enhancements to existing game mechanics.
A new tutorial is planned, which will then explain in the game what is important and not just in simple text form.
Graphical adjustments where it makes sense are also planned in the GUI and the world. Even after 1.0 there is no lack of ideas, there is still a lot of potential that can be used.

So now enough written. We thank you for your patience and hope you enjoy playing!
You are welcome to continue to share your feedback with us in order to make the game better.

notes.title: Roadmap Update 30.11.2020
notes.notes:
Hello everybody,

we would like to briefly announce that the new version will be postponed by a few weeks. We hope to be able to publish the new version in December.
Work on the new population system is taking longer than hoped and it will take more time to complete. Deeper interventions in the game code are necessary for this feature.
Still, we're making good progress and think that the new features are a good addition to the game.

Thank you for your understanding and we will contact you as soon as we can publish our update.

notes.title: Roadmap Update 20.10.2020
notes.notes:
Hello strategy friends!

It has been a while, but today we want to give you a brief summary and talk about the state of development and the future of our project.

Unfortunately, the development has been slowed down a bit in the last few months, but we are still well within the timeframe until the planned release in August 2021.
The development of the next update is currently in full swing and the finished game is also a good deal closer. We plan to release the next patch towards the end of November.

We'd like to give you a brief overview of what's available in the upcoming patch and what we're still working on. As always, we reserve the right to make changes:

1. Revision of the main menu and expanded empire and character creation.

2. Save and load.
With this version, we have finally decided to allow you to create your own save games in the game.
So far the game has "only" saved automatically (which continues to happen). In addition, the player can now create as many save games as his hard drive allows.
We'll be planning a few small improvements until the release, but that's a start.

3. Manual placement of buildings.
You can now optionally use a checkbox in the city administration to choose whether you would like to position the building yourself or whether you want to leave this to the AI.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35508633/dafb8546fee79c4a9ba90a02513e67eb11076e19.png

4. Expansion and better visibility of residents' needs.

5. New buildings (tannery and hunters) and modified building functions, including for the tavern.

6. Revised information on the negotiator in the diplomacy menu.

7. Various other changes to the game system.

8. Bug fixes should of course not be missing.

9. Inhabitants and offices version 1.
This point is currently taking up most of the development time and we hope to be able to complete it in the course of November.
Since the inhabitants are an important part of the game, we wanted to make some enhancements to the simulation there before the release.
For example there is now an overview in the cities and in the game overview of each individual inhabitant with various data such as age, gender, occupation, office.
As a result that every resident with their individual strengths and weaknesses can now take over an office, the previous system will be replaced.

Of course, a few more expansions and improvements are planned for this feature too, so stay tuned.

To conclude, we regret to inform you that the saves files will be unusable again in the upcoming and the following major patch. This is simply due to the major changes in the code.

So we want to shoot this roadmap with the fact that a larger version with expansions to the game is planned after the upcoming patch. After that, we will mainly focus on balancing, fine-tuning, smaller enhancements and performance until the release.
As already mentioned, we still have some ideas for our game after version 1.0, the to-do list is full of it. The future will show what else we can build in, and it's best to talk about that after the release.

That's it for now. As soon as the version is ready, we will inform you.

Last we wish you a lot of fun playing and of course, as always, thank you for your support and feedback!

notes.title: Progress and Patch (V0.66b) released!
notes.notes:
Hello strategy fans,

here it is, the next "not so small" patch (V0.66b) is finished.

The main focus for us was to make various AI improvements with this patch. AI should now act much better.
Of course there is still room for improvement and we will continue to work on it until the release.
Otherwise there are many adjustments in addition to bug fixes to improve the gaming experience.
On the other hand, we hand out another map on top, which this time takes you to a colder northern part of the world. Good luck!
In order not to make the text too long, you can read the full patch notes in the main menu of the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35508633/d9040a016792e5642d9df9ab9e1a1594b0216c58.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35508633/089dfbb59fa34b2dd941567fa44eede82458a81b.jpg

What's next?

As already mentioned, we are going back to work on new features. If there are no changes or problems, it will
probably the manual construction mode in cities where you can build your city like you want.
In addition, new buildings are likely to be introduced and the role of necessities for your residents will be increased, but also better represented for the player in order to be able to act accordingly.
Of course, more is planned, but we will announce that later.

But still, if critical bugs are found, we prior that in a hotfix before the next major patch.

Furthermore, as announced, we will now adjust the price somewhat. It should be said that everyone who supports us in Early Access actively helps with development up to 1.0 and beyond.

So thank you for your support for our game and all that remains is to say: Have fun playing and see you next time!

notes.title: Small Patch (V0.66a)
notes.notes:
Hello everybody,

as announced another small patch here. We are planning 1-2 more of these small patches before we start again with new features. Have fun playing!

Patchnotes:

- Switch to Unity 2019.3 and make the necessary adjustments.
- Further optimizations of the terrain graphics (city / nature).
- City borders could be in the air.
- Update and adjustments to pathfinding for better performance.
- Flag shader changed.
- Some buildings did not change the sub-floor during construction.
- Method added, which should prevent gaps in the terrain at its borders.
- Animation for residents changed.
- The daily speed is no longer tied to the frame rate. This should generally make the game run faster and more evenly each day.
- Fixed a bug that prevented fights and brought the game to a hold.
- A bug prevented the city wall from being upgraded for players and AI.
- Small bug fixes.

notes.title: Small Patch V0.66
notes.notes:
Hello everybody,

as announced a small patch to fix some bugs. A new special research is also included. You can read exactly what has changed in the game.

Attention: Unfortunately there was a core problem, which made it impossible to keep the savegames before this version. We are working on the fact that this will no longer be necessary in the future.

Have fun playing!

notes.title: Update V0.65 released and further announcements!
notes.notes:
Hello strategy fans,

our latest update for Civitas Nova is ready!

In order not to let this news get too long you can have a look at the full patch notes in the game or in the last Steam news.
The new gameplay trailer is expected to be available on Steam during the first week of May to better reflect the progress since EA release and as announced we will adjust the price at the same time to reflect the new features.
We want to make sure that the game runs as bug-free as possible beforehand, so we'll only do this with the small patch next week.
It should be noted that buying before version 1.0 helps us of course, but please note that we are a small team and are still in early access. We therefore recommend that if you expect a finished game to wait until 1.0.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35508633/277e61dee050ad1d8b99b22767c0723b5f482f4f.png

So what does the further plan look like?

As the game has become more complex since EA release, we will mainly deal with bug fixing, fine tuning and optimizations to the game and the AI ​​for the next 1-2 months and therefore probably patching 2-3 times in the period.
Included is a planned update to Unity 2019.3 to take advantage of some of the new features (including performance).

What comes after version 1.0?

After these small patches we want to tackle the last major features towards 1.0.
On the one hand, the expansion of the Empire management is planned and we will see how far we will go between complexity and
playability. NPC characters are planned in your empire who work for or against you and you should be able to influence this.
These NPC characters will also be able to hold various offices, replacing the simple assignments of city keeper, captain and research director.
In addition, it is planned to build in families / dynasties / factions that influence the empire. We will continuously check how far we can go into detail in the process.
Of course, the full loading and saving of several games is still planned. (Currently only the current game is automatically saved)
Of course, more is planned, such as new buildings, units such as spies, catapults, riders, etc., additional maps, manual placement of buildings in the city, a street system and much more. 
But be aware that we reserve the right to make changes if, in our opinion, the feature does not work or makes no sense.

Are there any plans after 1.0?

There are still a few ideas that we don't want to reveal yet.
But we can already say that after 1.0 we want to try out to build in a multiplayer mode.
Please note that this is not an announcement for a definite feature after 1.0!

That should conclude our news for today, so we want to say have fun playing and trying our game out.
We are of course grateful if you report any bugs, suggestions and criticisms you have found.
Otherwise, of course, we thank you for the support of our project!

notes.title: Update (0.65) scheduled for April 30th, 2020!
notes.notes:
Hello everybody,

today we would like to announce our latest update 0.65. This update is a very big undertaking for us and sets course strongly towards 1.0.
A few more important features and enhancements are of course planned on the way to 1.0, but more about them next time.

So here is the list for this update. (Subject to changes as always)

- New map: Rifik Islands (small tropical map)

World:

- Buildings are now visually represented in the world when they are built. Exceptions are currently walls, individual scaffolding and most levels of the government building.
(As of this update, enough space in the city is even more important.)
- Residents will now walk through the city and thus ensure more life.
- City area and buildings are now slightly larger to show more details.
- Known maps have been slightly changed / expanded for the above reason.
- The government building is now displayed in the world and built at start in the first city.
If this city is conquered by an enemy empire, the government building can be rebuilt in another city with the same tier.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35508633/eabaa884c81a20fddfeba5eca5fd182d1e77e849.png

Research:

- Research has been revised and expanded. There is now special research that unlocks new technology / opportunities.
In addition, the research menu now contains further information to help you plan better.
- Research time from area research decreased.
- Area research costs now increase significantly less per level.
- New area research bonuses can now be triggered by leveling up.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35508633/183bf61508123e5ec7fa0c9712e6f10c55bdda98.png

New units / structures / buildings:

- New unit: Archer.
This can be sent alone as a unit or support a melee unit and thus receive bonuses in combat through this symbiosis.
- New unit: Constructor.
This unit can build buildings outside of cities (mines and unit stores). In addition, when placed in a structure (e.g. city), there is a construction speed bonus of 10% and maintenance costs are reduced by 5%.
- New structure: Mine.
After research, these can be placed on ore deposits or occupied by other empires. This new structure offers a new possibility to supply your cities with raw materials but also to sell them to other cities and thus make more profit.
- New structure: Unit camp.
1 unit camp per empire can be builded. These help troops near an enemy to gather new strength and food for the attack.

- New building: Library.
This gives many bonuses to the city and improves research.
- New building: Prospectors and Charcoal burner. 
These replace the Mines in the cities.
- New building: Medicus 
Cares for the sick.

Mechanics

New mechanics: Sick / diseases
These arise particularly in larger cities. Sick people can die untreated and lower the city's satisfaction and production.
New mechanics: Food consumption by troops / units / officials.
So it has to be planned more tactically how far and what time of year you send your troops. Food is collected from barracks in the cities and also by them.
Troops also gather a certain amount of food around terrain if they are moving outsite of cities.

City administration

1. Walls have been removed as buildings and are now upgraded via tiers, similar to the palace. Visualization takes place in a later update.
2. Main house can now be improved over tiers.
3. Sick people and their effects are now shown.
4. The production efficiency is now shown and offers a tooltip for more information.
5. Building construction has been expanded and buildings can now be improved if researched.

Weather revisions:

1. Current weather is now displayed in the tooltip. (currently only in English)
2. Weather is now generated more comprehensibly and also saved properly. In particular, the quick change should now be omitted.

Unit management:

1. Officials / units / troops now take the food from the barracks stprage and no longer from the city where the barracks are located.
2. New display of the number of troops and maximum number.
3. Troop training is now possible. Troops that are in their own city can now be upgraded.
4. Food is now displayed.
5. "Speed" ​​changed in "survival" and includes speed and reduced food consumption at harsher temperatures.

AI:

- Adaptation of the AI ​​to the new circumstances with this update.
- Revision and optimization of some AI actions from older versions.
- Many code optimizations in the background also for future updates

Additional:

- Multiple selection of combat units is now possible. This makes it easier to move them together.
- Fast left mouse button presses now deselect units next to the escape key. If a structure is to be built, ESC and left click will now first cancel the structure.
If the left mouse button is pressed longer, the tracking shot is still possible without canceling the selection.
- The negotiation opportunity is now also displayed in the diplomacy overview. This makes it easier to see whether negotiations are worthwhile.
- Many other menu optimizations.
- There is now a new information window at the bottom left. This is currently shown when there is a shortage of food from the city or unit and when you are threatened with deportation.
- Different menus: Windows can now be minimized to see the tables better.
- Terrain is now changed in height from the structure (city, mine, etc.) and its maximum sphere of influence and no longer from individual buildings. This should be
lead to fewer drops in performance.
- Some terrain deformation improvements for better transitions.
- Cities now have 2 types of soil. Various improved buildings now have paving stones as a subsurface.
- The appearance of the construction selection of structures has been revised.
- In addition, there are many other small changes and improvements that we cannot name all. Have fun exploring!

Otherwise:

- Various bug fixes
- Various graphic revisions.
- Various minor optimizations.

notes.title: Progress on Update (Version 0.65)
notes.notes:
Hello strategy fans 

we would like to briefly inform you that the update will unfortunately be in development a little longer than we planned.
This is mainly due to the fact that the game is now very complex in its calculations for our small team and we are not yet completely satisfied with it
the integration of the new features. So there are still a few points on our to-do list and when they have been processed
the AI would also like to learn what has changed and further test rounds are also necessary.

As it is our biggest game update, we would like to ask for your patience and understanding. We are still very well on the schedule we had at the beginning of the
Early access.

We are therefore aiming for a new release date middle / end of April.

notes.title: Update News (V0.51) 16.12.2019
notes.notes:
A lot of this version is about performance adjustments and structural code revisions for upcoming things next year. 
Part of the gained performance was used for new systems.

Known problems:
1. When loading a level can currently cause Windows to report that the application is no longer responding. Just wait for a short time.
2. Too high settings for vegetation, reflection (on) is currently only recommended with very strong computers. We will continue to optimize these options to further improve overall performance.
3. There may be a short stutter, this happens due to an error in the pathfinding system. In addition, Autosave is still very resource-hungry and there is a short reduction in FPS for buildings and city placement.

New map: Kariba
This time in tropical setting, with different temperature conditions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35508633/817f619560bf142d32d8191cc66fd9511a0bd9d2.jpg

New feature: Barbarians
Larger tribes can give you an additional threat to the Civilized Empires.
This feature can be turned off before the game starts.
- Units revision. New look of your units, new animations and a new ship model.

Flags
Choose your own flag from various options that present your units in the game.

New vegetation system
With this system we could make many improvements to the flora and create much denser vegetation.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35508633/61c3e36852f559bc2ee3a75c735782f3900d66e0.jpg

More
- History has been changed in "Game overview" and includes 3 different types of victory conditions and the display of the current highscore.
- The Victory screen has been redesigned and put into its own scene.
- The victory must now be claimed and no longer happens automatically. (In game overview)
Now you can continue to play as long as you want.
- The day is longer now, so you shouldn't be in the dark half the time.
- Highscore calculation has been completely revised and points are now distributed daily.
- Conquest options: When a city has been defeated, the player now has 4 options to choose from (conquer, plunder, destroy, spare).
AI Empires will always conquer other Empires and loot barbarians.
- Setting: New options: Borderless Window, VSync, vegetation details
- Setting (change): Complex water became water reflections. Costs performance, so switch off on slow computers.
- Revision of the pathing calculation of units.
- An attack can now cause the building to be destroyed.
- Help and first steps updated.
- Much denser, more realistic vegetation added for all maps. Further optimizations follow.
- Other small graphical adjustments.
- Building pooling. (performance)
- New shader for snow and frost.
- Various performance improvements for cities, units and buildings.
- Display optimizations for cities and units in order to improve performance, especially with increasing numbers in the later game.
- Daily calculations have been greatly optimized to ensure better performance.
- Terrain manipulation of new buildings has been further optimized. Still work todo on that.
- Many more performance optimizations in the code.
- Many code adjustments and extensions for upcoming features.
- Weather status should now be saved.
- Various bugs fixed.

notes.title: Game update V0.51 scheduled for 16.12.2019!
notes.notes:
Hello everybody,

a new update is coming soon. We would like to tell you a bit about it.
To a large extent, this update includes performance improvements and structural changes to the code base.
This has taken up a greater amount of time than initially hoped for, but we think we've got a good foundation for bringing new features to the game faster.
While the foundation is laid with this update, research and changes in resource management will take place in the next big update.
Of course, there is more with this update, that should enrich the gameplay. Here is a small overview:

- The barbarians are coming!
This new threat can be activated optionally and offers another challenge on the way to victory. These tribes are not interested in expansion but in plunder and will be able to haunt all civilized realms.

- New vegetation system:
This finally allows us with still maintaining good performance, to represent denser vegetation. The details shown in the screenshot are on "Ultra Settings" and
will be further optimized with upcoming updates.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35508633/61c3e36852f559bc2ee3a75c735782f3900d66e0.jpg

- A new map is included with this update: Kariba
"Matching the season", we have installed a tropical-inspired map, which brings along with the new setting other temperature conditions.
As always we still doing updates to all our maps in future updates.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35508633/817f619560bf142d32d8191cc66fd9511a0bd9d2.jpg

- Flags/Banner system:
From now on you can design a flag/banner that your units will carry in game.

Additional:
- Conquest options after conquering a city: Conquer, plunder, destroy and spare are now possible.
- Units / ships have been revised.
- Revised Victory Conditions, with progress now showing.
- High score revised and will now be displayed in the game.
- New victory screen.
- Water reflections.
- New snow shader.
- Adjustments to game flow.
- Performance, structure and code optimizations (a lot).
- Day time is now longer than night time.
- Bug fixes and graphical optimizations in many places.
- Many more little things.

As indicated above, this update is scheduled for 16.12.2019. Changes to the deadline are possible if we discover errors / problems during testing.

Due to the still strong changes in game code, saving can unfortunately not be transferred to the new version.
Once this work has been completed, we will continue to expand the save system. We ask for patience here.

We still thank for the support, new additions for the game will follow next year, but more on that later. ;)

notes.title: Game Update (V0.42) 01. Oktober 2019!
notes.notes:
Hello everybody,

we are happy to announce our latest update.

Here are the key improvements:

Unit Manager:
[olist]
 Army administration has been renamed to Unit Management and redesigned to allow new features.
 Unit types: The first new unit type is the settler who joins the already available infantry.
 Barracks now have their own stock and get raw materials such as weapons, tools, etc. from the cities.
[/olist]

Establish cities:
[olist]
 Settlers can now build cities. At least 10 settlers in a unit are needed for a city.
 More settlers reduce the construction time. Settlers are converted into inhabitants during town construction.
[/olist]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35508633/8fc3944f385e0bb012b85fedfe52660f454a0a0d.jpg

Follow and field fight system:
[olist]
 Units can now track own or foreign units by clicking on them with a selected unit.
 If two enemy units come close, a battle standard is now set and a fight begins in the area.
[/olist]

Diplomacy extension:
[olist]
 There is now a conversation simulation in the negotiations that allows you to talk to other realms.
 Of course, conversations have a big impact on your relationship with the other realm. Furthermore, empires can now together declare war against another empire, but also denounce, praise and propose peace is possible.
 In addition, many of the diplomatic functions have been redesigned or updated.
 The GUI for negotiations was adjusted accordingly.
[/olist]

New water system
We changed our technical background to the water because the old shader was causing visual problems and poor performance.
The new system also adapts better to weather and day / night cycles and will offer more options in the future.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35508633/96051b8dea23f06db1261ccc206f394d96f7dad4.jpg

Artificial intelligence:
A lot of time has gone into this point and the code has almost doubled in the area.
The AI ​​now reacts to more things than before and of course to the new features, and it has been prepared for the next updates.
Since there are so many ways that the AI ​​can react, we will continue to monitor this and if necessary fix it with a hotfix before the next major update. We also welcome feedback.

Performance:
Many things could be optimized next to the water system and in many areas the game should run much smoother.
The largest bottlenecks are currently still deform terrain for buildings and so on and autosave take 1-2 seconds to get done.
Both will be looked into with the upcoming updates and improved to make our cities more lively. (Visible inhabitants, more types of buildings, etc.)

First steps:
In the title menu, "Getting started" has been added. It's not a complete tutorial yet, but hopefully will help some of you to get started.
Please feel free to use the help while you play (via ? reachable) or write us on Steam, in the game under "Feedback" or info@civitas-nova.com, if it is needed.

More stuff:
- Graphical revisions.
- Bugfixes
- Fine tuning
- Many more small things.
- Code optimizations

Finally, first information about the next update:
- Expansion of research opportunities.
- Change in resource management.
- Another new unit type.
- Structures next to cities that can be placed in the world.
- Many more small and bigger things of course.

In addition, another feature is planned, which we will announce later. So stay tuned. :)

The whole update is planned for December.

So now we wish you a lot of fun playing! Feedback is, of course, very welcome as always. So write us!

notes.title: Short patch announcement for the 1st of October 2019
notes.notes:
Hello strategy fans,

our first EA content update is nearing completion.
Currently, the last adjustments to the AI is ​​made and, of course, much fine tuning and every bug we found,

and an expanded diplomacy, which, among other things, allows conversations with other empires. Of course there are many more things that we will announced later in the patch notes.
